literature.title: Impact of cenobamate on cortical responses to transcranial magnetic stimulation in people with drug-resistant focal epilepsy
literature.summary: CNB增加静息运动阈值，提示钠通道效应不能完全解释CNB疗效，GABA-A调节可能是更关键的疗效来源。

literature.title: Does adjunctive Cenobamate lead to a reduction in the use of vagal nerve stimulation? A long-term observational study
literature.summary: CNB添加治疗使57%等待VNS手术患者推迟植入，61.5%患者发作减少≥50%，具有显著经济效益。

literature.title: Effectiveness and safety of cenobamate after conversion to monotherapy or duotherapy in real-world practice
literature.summary: CNB转换为单药或双药治疗的真实世界研究，31.5%患者达到无发作，88%患者成功减少联合用药数量。

literature.title: Precision management of cenobamate in drug-resistant epilepsy: integrating pharmacogenetics, therapeutic drug monitoring, and real-world clinical strategies
literature.summary: 综述提出整合药物遗传学、治疗药物监测和真实世界策略的CNB精准管理框架，强调个体化滴定方案。

literature.title: Cenobamate in pediatric drug-resistant epilepsy: real-world evidence from a two-center retrospective study
literature.summary: 两中心回顾性研究证实CNB在儿童耐药性癫痫中的疗效与安全性，为儿童人群用药提供真实世界证据。

literature.title: Long-term impact of cenobamate on cognition, adaptive behavior, and quality of life in patients with tuberous sclerosis complex
literature.summary: CNB对结节性硬化症患者的认知功能、适应行为和生活质量有长期积极影响，未观察到认知恶化。

literature.title: Real-world use of cenobamate in paediatric drug-resistant epilepsy: long-term efficacy, safety, and co-medication adjustment
literature.summary: CNB在儿童耐药性癫痫中长期有效且安全，联合用药可逐步调整减少，支持儿童人群的长期使用。

literature.title: Cenobamate as add-on treatment for SCN8A developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
literature.summary: 多中心回顾性研究评估CNB作为SCN8A发育性和癫痫性脑病的添加治疗，为精准治疗提供证据。

literature.title: Comparative effectiveness of brivaracetam, cenobamate, lacosamide, and perampanel in focal epilepsy: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
literature.summary: 网络Meta分析比较四种抗癫痫药在局灶性癫痫中的疗效，CNB在发作减少率和无发作率方面表现突出。

literature.title: Real-world evidence on cenobamate monotherapy in epilepsy: impact on healthcare utilization
literature.summary: 理赔数据分析显示CNB单药治疗显著降低住院天数（3.22→0.7天/年）和急诊就诊（0.83→0.27次/年），近44%患者无不良事件。

literature.title: Unraveling the adverse effects and safety profile of cenobamate: a comprehensive review
literature.journal: Journal of Advanced Trends in Medical Research
literature.summary: 综述指出CNB辅助治疗可实现55%月发作减少和28%无发作率，但需缓慢滴定以降低DRESS等严重不良事件风险。

literature.title: Early response rates with adjunctive cenobamate in uncontrolled focal seizures: open-label extension of a randomized clinical study in a multinational Asian population
literature.summary: 亚洲多国人群随机临床研究的开放标签扩展显示CNB添加治疗的早期应答率，支持在亚洲人群中的疗效。

literature.title: Efficacy of adjunctive cenobamate by focal seizure subtypes: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter study in a multinational Asian population
literature.summary: 按局灶性发作亚型分析疗效的随机双盲安慰剂对照多中心研究，证实CNB对不同发作亚型均有效。

literature.title: Clarification of the mechanism of action of cenobamate: dual modulation of persistent sodium current and GABA-A receptors
literature.summary: 阐明CNB双重机制：选择性阻断持续性钠电流和正向变构调节GABA-A受体，GABA-A调节不被氟马西尼逆转，作用于非苯二氮卓类结合位点。
